title: Kado buñu bañ
intro: Bi taarixu nit ñi di tàmbali, bi suuf si di ndaw ba leegi, àdduna bi di noyyi bu njëkk, amoon na ruuh bu taxaw ci kanamu Boroom bi, yóbbaale sarax bu woyof. Sarax boobu dañu ko teg ci balansu nangug Yàlla — ñu gis ni daa ñàkk. Li ci topp bokkul ak jaar-jaaru baale, waaye xol bu fees dell ak fiiraange, mu dem ba def jëf ju kenn duko delloo ginaaw, te dina wéy di am ci àdduna bi yépp. Lii mooy jaar-jaaru kenn ku turam nekkoon luy nuru njubadi bu rëy biñ njëkka def.
clues: Man maay nekk benn ci xale yi njëkka judd, juddoo ci waajur bu xam jaar-jaaram bu baax.
Benn bis dama saraxe Yàlla sarax, waaye nangu wuma ko, doonte saraxu sama mbokk nangu nañu ko ci yitte.
Ci ñeel ak mer daal di dugg ci sama xol, ma ni damay ray samay mbokk.
Sama mbokk daf ma artu ma ragal Yàlla, waaye sama ngor nanguwul ma déglu ko.
Ci jamonoy néew doole bu metti, def naa sama rak jëf ju kenn mënul wax.
Ginaaw loolu, xamuma woon ni may nëbbee li ma def, ba keroog ñu yónnee ma benn mbindéef ci kaw suuf ngir jàngal ma.

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
